integrity: The proof is supplied in full; mathematical checker output gives finite corroboration only. Previously known exact mixture and product-tail machinery are credited.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes observation time and all positive parameters; its rare-displacement asymptotics are not uniform in simultaneous time or tempering limits. Unindexed broader product-tail or conditioning results may overlap the contribution.
title: Fixed-time stretched spatial tails and jointly selected disorder in tempered fractional Laplace transport
